## Shiny

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(purrr)
library(plotly)
library(stringr)
library(officer) 

# --- 1. Load and Prepare Data ---
apps <- read.csv("model_applications.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
criteria_df <- read.csv("model_criteria.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
glossary <- read.csv("glossary_app.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

MODEL_TYPES <- c(
  "Explanation (Hypothesis testing)",
  "Predictions (spatially explicit)",
  "Predictions (Non-spatially explicit)",
  "Projection (Extrapolation)"
)

# Standardize model-type column names across input files.
names(criteria_df)[names(criteria_df) == "Predictions (Spatially explicit)"] <- "Predictions (spatially explicit)"

repair_mojibake <- function(x) {
  mojibake_pattern <- paste(c("\\u00c3", "\\u00c2", "\\u00e2"), collapse = "|")
  needs_repair <- !is.na(x) & str_detect(x, mojibake_pattern)
  repaired <- iconv(x[needs_repair], from = "CP1252", to = "UTF-8")
  x[needs_repair] <- ifelse(is.na(repaired), x[needs_repair], repaired)
  x
}

repair_text_columns <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), repair_mojibake))
}

validate_columns <- function(df, required_cols, file_label) {
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        file_label,
        " is missing required column(s): ",
        paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

validate_columns(
  apps,
  c(
    "Model_application_category", "Definition", "Model_application_subcategory",
    "Purpose_problem_to solve", "How_predictions_inform_decisions",
    "Omission_errors", "Commission_errors", "What_practitioners_want",
    "Reference_example", MODEL_TYPES
  ),
  "model_applications.csv"
)

validate_columns(
  criteria_df,
  c(
    "Key_stages", "Criterion", "Assumption_Description",
    "Violation_of_Assumptions", "Omission_errors", "Commission_errors",
    "Potential_Solutions", "Author_reference", MODEL_TYPES
  ),
  "model_criteria.csv"
)

validate_columns(glossary, c("Term", "Definition"), "glossary_app.csv")

apps <- repair_text_columns(apps)
criteria_df <- repair_text_columns(criteria_df)
glossary <- repair_text_columns(glossary)

read_landing_docx <- function(filepath) {
  if(!file.exists(filepath)) return(rep("", 20))
  doc <- read_docx(filepath)
  content <- docx_summary(doc)
  text_lines <- content$text[content$content_type == "paragraph"]
  text_lines <- text_lines[text_lines != "" & !is.na(text_lines) & text_lines != "NA"]
  return(repair_mojibake(text_lines))
}

landing_lines <- read_landing_docx("tab1_landing_page_intro.docx")

clean_flags <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(across(any_of(MODEL_TYPES), ~ {
    val <- as.numeric(.)
    ifelse(is.na(val), 0, val)
  }))
}
apps <- clean_flags(apps)
criteria_df <- clean_flags(criteria_df)

RISK_LEVELS <- c("Very high", "High", "Moderate", "Low")
RISK_COLORS <- c("Very high" = "#ff4d4d", "High" = "#ffb3b3", "Moderate" = "#ffffcc", "Low" = "#c2f0c2")
RISK_BORDER_COLORS <- c("Very high" = "#d32f2f", "High" = "#f48fb1", "Moderate" = "#fbc02d", "Low" = "#388e3c")

# --- 3. Server ---
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  selected_row_data <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  submitted_purpose <- reactiveVal("")

  selected_app <- reactive({
    req(input$cat_select, input$subcat_select)
    app_row <- apps %>%
      filter(
        Model_application_category == input$cat_select,
        Model_application_subcategory == input$subcat_select
      ) %>%
      slice(1)
    req(nrow(app_row) > 0)
    app_row
  })

  selected_model_types <- reactive({
    if (is.null(input$type_select) || length(input$type_select) == 0) {
      "None selected"
    } else {
      paste(input$type_select, collapse = ", ")
    }
  })

  apply_suggested_risks <- function() {
    app_row <- selected_app()
    updateSelectInput(session, "omission_filter", selected = app_row$Omission_errors)
    updateSelectInput(session, "commission_filter", selected = app_row$Commission_errors)
    updateSelectInput(session, "risk_match_mode", selected = "any")
  }

  get_risk_style <- function(level) {
    color <- RISK_COLORS[level]
    if(is.na(color)) color <- "#ffffff"
    paste0(
      "background-color: ", color,
      "; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: bold;",
      " border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); color: #333;"
    )
  }

  display_risk_value <- function(value, selected_filter) {
    if (is.null(selected_filter)) return(value)
    if (selected_filter == "" || risk_at_or_above(value, selected_filter)) value else ""
  }

  risk_at_or_above <- function(value, selected_filter) {
    if (is.null(selected_filter) || selected_filter == "") return(TRUE)
    value_rank <- match(value, RISK_LEVELS)
    selected_rank <- match(selected_filter, RISK_LEVELS)
    !is.na(value_rank) & !is.na(selected_rank) & value_rank <= selected_rank
  }

  risk_threshold_label <- function(selected_filter) {
    if (is.null(selected_filter) || selected_filter == "") return("No risk filter")
    paste(selected_filter, "or higher")
  }

  match_reason <- function(omission_value, commission_value) {
    om_val <- input$omission_filter
    com_val <- input$commission_filter
    if (is.null(om_val)) om_val <- ""
    if (is.null(com_val)) com_val <- ""
    if (om_val == "" && com_val == "") return("Included by selected model type")
    om_match <- om_val != "" && risk_at_or_above(omission_value, om_val)
    com_match <- com_val != "" && risk_at_or_above(commission_value, com_val)
    if (om_match && com_match) return("Matched omission and commission risk thresholds")
    if (om_match) return("Matched omission risk threshold")
    if (com_match) return("Matched commission risk threshold")
    "Included"
  }

  add_match_reason <- function(df) {
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
    df %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(Match_reason = match_reason(Omission_errors, Commission_errors)) %>%
      ungroup()
  }

  risk_summary_table <- function(df, error_col, selected_level) {
    stages <- sort(unique(criteria_df$Key_stages))
    stages <- stages[stages != "" & !is.na(stages)]
    if (is.null(selected_level) || selected_level == "") {
      return(data.frame(Key_stages = stages, Risk_level = "None selected", Count = 0))
    }
    counts <- df %>%
      filter(risk_at_or_above(!!sym(error_col), selected_level)) %>%
      count(Key_stages, name = "Count")
    data.frame(Key_stages = stages) %>%
      left_join(counts, by = "Key_stages") %>%
      mutate(
        Risk_level = risk_threshold_label(selected_level),
        Count = ifelse(is.na(Count), 0, Count)
      ) %>%
      select(Key_stages, Risk_level, Count)
  }

  observeEvent(input$cat_select, {
    updateSelectInput(session, "type_select", selected = character(0))
    updateSelectInput(session, "omission_filter", selected = "")
    updateSelectInput(session, "commission_filter", selected = "")
    updateSelectInput(session, "risk_match_mode", selected = "any")
    selected_row_data(NULL)
  })

  observeEvent(input$subcat_select, {
    updateSelectInput(session, "type_select", selected = character(0))
    apply_suggested_risks()
    selected_row_data(NULL)
  })

  observeEvent(input$reset_filters, {
    updateSelectInput(session, "type_select", selected = character(0))
    apply_suggested_risks()
    selected_row_data(NULL)
  })

  observeEvent(input$submit_purpose, {
    submitted_purpose(input$user_purpose)
    updateTextAreaInput(session, "user_purpose", value = "")
  })

  create_glossary_links <- function(text) {
    if (is.null(text) || text == "" || is.na(text) || text == "NA") return("")
    terms <- glossary$Term
    terms <- terms[order(nchar(terms), decreasing = TRUE)]
    processed_text <- text
    for (term in terms) {
      escaped_term <- str_replace_all(term, "([.|()\\^{}+$*?\\[\\]\\\\])", "\\\\\\1")
      pattern <- paste0("(?i)\\b(", escaped_term, ")(s|es)?\\b(?!([^<]*>))")
      if (str_detect(processed_text, pattern)) {
        term_js <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\\\\\", term)
        term_js <- gsub("'", "\\\\'", term_js, fixed = TRUE)
        replacement <- paste0("<a class='glossary-link' onclick=\"Shiny.setInputValue('glossary_click', '", term_js, "', {priority: 'event'})\">\\0</a>")
        processed_text <- str_replace(processed_text, pattern, replacement)
      }
    }
    return(HTML(processed_text))
  }

  output$full_landing_page <- renderUI({
    req(landing_lines)
    idx_goal <- which(str_detect(landing_lines, "^Goal$"))[1]
    idx_motivation <- which(str_detect(landing_lines, "^Motivation$"))[1]
    idx_approach <- which(str_detect(landing_lines, "^Approach$"))[1]
    idx_proceed <- which(str_detect(landing_lines, "How to proceed\\?"))[1]
    format_dynamic_line <- function(line) {
      if(str_detect(line, "^[0-9]+\\.")) {
        parts <- str_split(line, " : ", n = 2)[[1]]
        if(length(parts) > 1) tags$p(style="margin-bottom: 2px;", tags$strong(paste0(parts[1], ":")), create_glossary_links(parts[2])) 
        else tags$p(style="margin-bottom: 2px;", tags$strong(line))
      } else tags$p(style="margin-bottom: 2px;", create_glossary_links(line))
    }
    tagList(
      div(class = "centered-intro", h3(landing_lines[1]), h4(style = "color: #2c3e50; font-weight: bold;", landing_lines[2])),
      div(class="guide-section", h4(style="color: #18bc9c;", landing_lines[idx_goal]), p(create_glossary_links(paste(landing_lines[(idx_goal+1):(idx_motivation-1)], collapse = " ")))),
      div(class="guide-section", h4(style="color: #2980b9;", landing_lines[idx_motivation]), tags$ul(style="padding-left: 20px;", lapply(landing_lines[(idx_motivation+1):(idx_approach-1)], function(line) { if(!str_detect(line, "\\?")) tags$li(create_glossary_links(line)) else tags$p(style="margin-left: -20px; font-weight: bold;", create_glossary_links(line)) }))),
      div(class="guide-section", h4(style="color: #e67e22;", landing_lines[idx_approach]), p(create_glossary_links(paste(landing_lines[(idx_approach+1):(idx_proceed-1)], collapse = " ")))),
      div(class="guide-section", h4(style="color: #e74c3c;", landing_lines[idx_proceed]), lapply(landing_lines[(idx_proceed + 1):length(landing_lines)], format_dynamic_line))
    )
  })

  base_filtered <- reactive({
    df <- criteria_df
    if (!is.null(input$type_select) && length(input$type_select) > 0) {
      valid_cols <- intersect(input$type_select, names(df))
      if(length(valid_cols) > 0) {
        mask <- rowSums(df[valid_cols] == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
        df <- df[mask, ]
      }
    }
    df
  })
  
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    df <- base_filtered()
    om_val <- input$omission_filter
    com_val <- input$commission_filter
    if (is.null(om_val)) om_val <- ""
    if (is.null(com_val)) com_val <- ""
    if (om_val == "" && com_val == "") return(df)
    
    if (om_val != "" && com_val != "") {
      if (identical(input$risk_match_mode, "all")) {
        df <- df %>%
          filter(
            risk_at_or_above(Omission_errors, om_val) &
              risk_at_or_above(Commission_errors, com_val)
          )
      } else {
        df <- df %>%
          filter(
            risk_at_or_above(Omission_errors, om_val) |
              risk_at_or_above(Commission_errors, com_val)
          )
      }
    } else if (om_val != "") {
      df <- df %>% filter(risk_at_or_above(Omission_errors, om_val))
    } else {
      df <- df %>% filter(risk_at_or_above(Commission_errors, com_val))
    }
    df
  })

  output$selection_display_tab2 <- renderUI({
    req(input$cat_select, input$subcat_select)
    div(class = "selection-bar", paste0("You have selected: ", input$cat_select, " (", input$subcat_select, ") + ", selected_model_types()))
  })

  output$app_profile_display <- renderUI({
    req(input$cat_select, input$subcat_select)
    row <- selected_app()
    type_defs <- if (!is.null(input$type_select) && length(input$type_select) > 0) {
      lapply(input$type_select, function(t) {
        def_row <- glossary %>% filter(Term == t); if(nrow(def_row) > 0) {
          div(style = "margin-bottom: 10px;", tags$strong(t, ": "), create_glossary_links(def_row$Definition))
        } else NULL
      })
    } else ""
    tagList(
      div(class = "profile-box", 
          h3(style = "color: #2c3e50; border-bottom: 2px solid #2c3e50;", row$Model_application_category), p(em(create_glossary_links(row$Definition)))),
      div(class = "profile-box profile-box-muted", 
          h4(style = "color: #18bc9c;", row$Model_application_subcategory), hr(), 
          p(strong("Purpose: "), create_glossary_links(row[["Purpose_problem_to solve"]])), 
          p(strong("Decision Impact: "), create_glossary_links(row$How_predictions_inform_decisions)), 
          p(strong("Reference Example: "), HTML(as.character(row$Reference_example)))),
      if (length(input$type_select) > 0) div(class = "profile-box profile-box-info", 
                                             h4(style = "color: #2980b9; font-size: 1.1em;", "Selected Model Types:"), type_defs),
      if (submitted_purpose() != "") div(class = "profile-box profile-box-purpose",
                                         h4(style = "color: #16a085; font-size: 1.1em;", "My specific application purpose:"), p(style = "font-style: italic;", submitted_purpose()))
    )
  })

  output$selection_display_tab3 <- renderUI({
    req(input$cat_select, input$subcat_select)
    app_row <- selected_app()
    needs_split <- unlist(strsplit(app_row$What_practitioners_want, ",(?=[^,]*$|\\s*['\"])", perl = TRUE)) 
    risk_mode_text <- if (identical(input$risk_match_mode, "all")) "both selected risk thresholds" else "either selected risk threshold"
    tagList(
      h4(style = "color: #2c3e50; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 10px;", "Model Application Summary"),
      div(class = "selection-bar", paste0("You have selected: ", input$cat_select, " (", input$subcat_select, ") + ", selected_model_types()),
          div(style = "margin-top: 10px; font-weight: normal; font-size: 0.9em; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); padding-top: 10px;",
              strong("Suggested Risk for selection:"), br(),
              span(style = "margin-left: 10px;", "Omission: ", span(style = get_risk_style(app_row$Omission_errors), app_row$Omission_errors)),
              span(style = "margin-left: 20px;", "Commission: ", span(style = get_risk_style(app_row$Commission_errors), app_row$Commission_errors)),
              br(), br(), strong("Active filter rule: "), paste("Criteria match", risk_mode_text, "or anything higher when both omission and commission risks are selected."),
              br(), br(), strong("Practitioner Needs:"),
              tags$ul(style = "margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 0;", lapply(needs_split, function(n) tags$li(create_glossary_links(trimws(n)))))
          )
      ),
      h4(style = "color: #2c3e50; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 20px; border-bottom: 2px solid #18bc9c; padding-bottom: 5px;", "Criteria selected based on your risk tolerance")
    )
  })

  render_radar_logic <- function(df_base, error_col, filter_input) {
    stages <- sort(unique(criteria_df$Key_stages)); stages <- stages[stages != "" & !is.na(stages)]
    p <- plot_ly(type = 'scatterpolar', fill = 'toself')
    lvl <- filter_input
    max_range <- 10
    if (lvl != "") {
        counts <- df_base %>% filter(risk_at_or_above(!!sym(error_col), lvl)) %>% group_by(Key_stages) %>% summarise(n = n(), .groups = 'drop')
        plot_df <- data.frame(Key_stages = stages) %>% left_join(counts, by = "Key_stages") %>% mutate(n = ifelse(is.na(n), 0, n))
        max_range <- max(10, ceiling(max(plot_df$n, na.rm = TRUE) / 5) * 5)
        display_labels <- gsub("Data quality, relevance and preparation", "Data sets", plot_df$Key_stages)
        display_labels <- gsub(" ", "<br>", display_labels)
        p <- p %>% add_trace(r = c(plot_df$n, plot_df$n[1]), theta = c(display_labels, display_labels[1]), 
                             name = risk_threshold_label(lvl), fillcolor = RISK_COLORS[lvl], line = list(color = RISK_BORDER_COLORS[lvl], width = 2), opacity = 0.5)
    }
    p %>% layout(margin = list(l = 60, r = 60, t = 10, b = 10),
      polar = list(domain = list(x = c(0.1, 0.9), y = c(0.05, 0.95)), 
        radialaxis = list(visible = TRUE, range = c(0, max_range), angle = 0, tickangle = 0, tickfont = list(size = 9))), 
      showlegend = FALSE)
  }

  render_empty_radar <- function(message) {
    plot_ly() %>%
      layout(
        xaxis = list(visible = FALSE),
        yaxis = list(visible = FALSE),
        annotations = list(
          text = message,
          x = 0.5,
          y = 0.5,
          xref = "paper",
          yref = "paper",
          showarrow = FALSE
        ),
        margin = list(l = 20, r = 20, t = 10, b = 10)
      )
  }

  output$radar_omission <- renderPlotly({
    if (is.null(input$omission_filter) || input$omission_filter == "") return(render_empty_radar("Select an omission risk level"))
    render_radar_logic(base_filtered(), "Omission_errors", input$omission_filter)
  })
  output$radar_commission <- renderPlotly({
    if (is.null(input$commission_filter) || input$commission_filter == "") return(render_empty_radar("Select a commission risk level"))
    render_radar_logic(base_filtered(), "Commission_errors", input$commission_filter)
  })

  output$criteria_count <- renderUI({
    all_count <- nrow(criteria_df)
    type_count <- nrow(base_filtered())
    filtered_count <- nrow(filtered_data())
    div(
      class = "criteria-count",
      paste0(
        "Showing ", filtered_count, " of ", all_count,
        " criteria (", type_count, " match the selected model type filter)."
      )
    )
  })

  output$criteria_tables_ui <- renderUI({
    data <- filtered_data()
    if(nrow(data) == 0) {
      return(div(class = "empty-state", "No criteria match this combination. Try selecting another model type, changing the risk level, or switching the risk filter rule."))
    }
    stages <- unique(data$Key_stages)
    map(stages, function(s) { tagList(h5(style="margin-top:15px; border-bottom: 1px solid #ccc; font-weight:bold; font-size: 0.9em;", s), DTOutput(paste0("table_", gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "_", s)))) })
  })

  observe({
    data <- filtered_data()
    for (s in unique(data$Key_stages)) {
      local({
        curr_s <- s
        output[[paste0("table_", gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "_", curr_s))]] <- renderDT({
          df_subset <- data %>% filter(Key_stages == curr_s) %>% 
            select(Criterion, Omission_errors, Commission_errors) %>%
            add_match_reason() %>%
            mutate(
              Omission_errors = mapply(display_risk_value, Omission_errors, input$omission_filter),
              Commission_errors = mapply(display_risk_value, Commission_errors, input$commission_filter)
            )
          datatable(df_subset, selection = 'single', rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = 't', paging = FALSE, columnDefs = list(list(width = '35%', targets = 0), list(width = '20%', targets = 1), list(width = '20%', targets = 2), list(width = '25%', targets = 3)))) %>%
            formatStyle('Omission_errors', backgroundColor = styleEqual(names(RISK_COLORS), RISK_COLORS)) %>%
            formatStyle('Commission_errors', backgroundColor = styleEqual(names(RISK_COLORS), RISK_COLORS))
        })
        observeEvent(input[[paste0("table_", gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "_", curr_s), "_rows_selected")]], {
          idx <- input[[paste0("table_", gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "_", curr_s), "_rows_selected")]];
          selected_row_data(data %>% filter(Key_stages == curr_s) %>% slice(idx))
        })
      })
    }
  })

  output$report_criteria_table <- renderDT({
    data <- filtered_data()
    if(nrow(data) == 0) {
      return(datatable(data.frame(Message = "No criteria match the current selections."), rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = 't', paging = FALSE)))
    }
    report_df <- data %>%
      select(Criterion, Key_stages, Omission_errors, Commission_errors) %>%
      add_match_reason() %>%
      mutate(
        Omission_errors = mapply(display_risk_value, Omission_errors, input$omission_filter),
        Commission_errors = mapply(display_risk_value, Commission_errors, input$commission_filter)
      )
    datatable(report_df, rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = 't', paging = FALSE, columnDefs = list(list(width = '25%', targets = 0), list(width = '20%', targets = 1), list(width = '18%', targets = 2), list(width = '18%', targets = 3), list(width = '19%', targets = 4)))) %>%
      formatStyle('Omission_errors', backgroundColor = styleEqual(names(RISK_COLORS), RISK_COLORS)) %>%
      formatStyle('Commission_errors', backgroundColor = styleEqual(names(RISK_COLORS), RISK_COLORS))
  })

  output$report_tab_content <- renderUI({
    req(input$cat_select, input$subcat_select)
    app_row <- selected_app()
    tagList(
      div(class = "section-title", "Application Context"),
      div(class = "report-box",
          h4(style="color: #2c3e50; margin-top:0;", paste("Category:", input$cat_select)),
          h5(style="color: #18bc9c;", paste("Subcategory:", input$subcat_select)),
          p(strong("Selected Model Types: "), selected_model_types()),
          p(strong("Suggested Omission Risk: "), app_row$Omission_errors),
          p(strong("Suggested Commission Risk: "), app_row$Commission_errors),
          p(strong("Active Risk Filter Rule: "), ifelse(identical(input$risk_match_mode, "all"), "Match both selected risk thresholds", "Match either selected risk threshold")),
          p(strong("Team Overview: "), input$team_overview)),
      div(class = "section-title", "The purpose of my model application"),
      div(class = "report-box", if(submitted_purpose() == "") p(em("No purpose described.")) else p(submitted_purpose())),
      div(class = "section-title", "Relevant criteria for your application"),
      div(class = "report-box",
          div(class = "criteria-count", paste0("Showing ", nrow(filtered_data()), " criteria.")),
          fluidRow(column(6, h6("Omission Risk Summary", align="center"), plotlyOutput("radar_omission_report", height = "280px")), column(6, h6("Commission Risk Summary", align="center"), plotlyOutput("radar_commission_report", height = "280px"))),
          hr(),
          DTOutput("report_criteria_table"))
    )
  })

  output$radar_omission_report <- renderPlotly({
    if (is.null(input$omission_filter) || input$omission_filter == "") return(render_empty_radar("Select an omission risk level"))
    render_radar_logic(base_filtered(), "Omission_errors", input$omission_filter)
  })
  output$radar_commission_report <- renderPlotly({
    if (is.null(input$commission_filter) || input$commission_filter == "") return(render_empty_radar("Select a commission risk level"))
    render_radar_logic(base_filtered(), "Commission_errors", input$commission_filter)
  })

  output$download_docx <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() { paste("SDM-Report-", Sys.Date(), ".docx", sep="") },
    content = function(file) {
      app_row <- selected_app()
      report_data <- filtered_data() %>%
        select(Criterion, Key_stages, Omission_errors, Commission_errors) %>%
        add_match_reason() %>%
        mutate(
          Omission_errors = mapply(display_risk_value, Omission_errors, input$omission_filter),
          Commission_errors = mapply(display_risk_value, Commission_errors, input$commission_filter)
        )

      if (nrow(report_data) == 0) {
        report_data <- data.frame(Message = "No criteria match the current selections.")
      }

      omission_summary <- risk_summary_table(base_filtered(), "Omission_errors", input$omission_filter)
      commission_summary <- risk_summary_table(base_filtered(), "Commission_errors", input$commission_filter)
      risk_rule <- ifelse(identical(input$risk_match_mode, "all"), "Match both selected risk thresholds", "Match either selected risk threshold")

      doc <- read_docx() %>% 
        body_add_par("SDM Application & Criteria Report", style = "heading 1") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Prepared by:", input$user_name), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Report Date:", input$report_date), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
        
        body_add_par("1. Application Context", style = "heading 2") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Application Category:", input$cat_select), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Application Subcategory:", input$subcat_select), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Selected Model Types:", selected_model_types()), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Suggested Omission Risk:", app_row$Omission_errors), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Suggested Commission Risk:", app_row$Commission_errors), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Active Risk Filter Rule:", risk_rule), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("Purpose / Problem to Solve:", style = "heading 3") %>%
        body_add_par(ifelse(app_row[["Purpose_problem_to solve"]] == "", "N/A", app_row[["Purpose_problem_to solve"]]), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("How Predictions Inform Decisions:", style = "heading 3") %>%
        body_add_par(ifelse(app_row$How_predictions_inform_decisions == "", "N/A", app_row$How_predictions_inform_decisions), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
        
        body_add_par("2. Purpose of Model Application", style = "heading 2") %>%
        body_add_par(ifelse(submitted_purpose() == "", "No specific purpose provided.", submitted_purpose()), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("Team Overview / Project Context:", style = "heading 3") %>%
        body_add_par(ifelse(input$team_overview == "", "N/A", input$team_overview), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
        
        body_add_par("3. Recommended Criteria", style = "heading 2") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Number of criteria included:", nrow(filtered_data())), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Omission Filter Applied:", risk_threshold_label(input$omission_filter)), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par(paste("Commission Filter Applied:", risk_threshold_label(input$commission_filter)), style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("Omission Risk Counts by Model Stage", style = "heading 3") %>%
        body_add_table(omission_summary, style = "table_template") %>%
        body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("Commission Risk Counts by Model Stage", style = "heading 3") %>%
        body_add_table(commission_summary, style = "table_template") %>%
        body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
        body_add_par("Criteria Table", style = "heading 3") %>%
        body_add_table(report_data, style = "table_template")
      
      print(doc, target = file)
    }
  )

  output$download_csv <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() { paste("SDM-Criteria-", Sys.Date(), ".csv", sep="") },
    content = function(file) { write.csv(add_match_reason(filtered_data()), file, row.names = FALSE) }
  )

  output$details_panel <- renderUI({
    res <- selected_row_data(); if (is.null(res)) return(p(em("Click a criterion to view details.")))
    tagList(
      p(strong("Criterion: "), res$Criterion),
      p(strong("Assumption:"), br(), create_glossary_links(res$Assumption_Description)), 
      p(strong(style="color: #d63384;", "Violation Risks:"), br(), div(style="font-size: 0.85em; background-color: #fff0f7; padding: 8px; border-left: 4px solid #d63384;", create_glossary_links(res$Violation_of_Assumptions))), 
      p(strong(style="color: #27ae60;", "Potential Solutions:"), br(), div(style="font-size: 0.85em; background-color: #f4fdf7; padding: 8px; border-left: 4px solid #27ae60;", create_glossary_links(res$Potential_Solutions))), 
      p(strong("Reference: "), br(), span(style="font-size: 0.8em;", HTML(as.character(res$Author_reference))))
    )
  })

  output$subcat_ui <- renderUI({
    req(input$cat_select); choices <- apps %>% filter(Model_application_category == input$cat_select) %>% pull(Model_application_subcategory) %>% unique() %>% sort()
    selectInput("subcat_select", "Select Application Subcategory:", choices = choices)
  })

  observeEvent(input$glossary_click, {
    term_info <- glossary %>% filter(Term == input$glossary_click) %>% slice(1)
    req(nrow(term_info) > 0)
    showModal(modalDialog(title = term_info$Term, p(term_info$Definition), easyClose = TRUE))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
